elaine: Quick ask 1: field wants a single-page preflight checklist + clear blocked vs deferred rules for Private (VPC/on-prem). Can we land this in thread?

omar: yes. propose two columns: HARD BLOCKERS (no launch) and ALLOWED WITH MITIGATION. short, actionable items.

jin: HARD: BGP/static peering active and validated, offline bundle checksum verified, operator manifests pinned to semver, and audit export to customer SIEM proven.

carla: add MUST: health endpoint stable (5 checks), kv cache persistent across restart, and model loads without runtime errors. if not, block.

ryan: network specifics MUST: show BGP neighbor UP or static routes with test traffic; provide a packet capture showing SYN/ACK to our endpoints; verify MTU alignment.

jin: performance gate: run 500 sample calls to capture p50/p95. if p95 > 2.5s block unless customer signs latency waiver.

omar: PACKAGING musts: airgapped installer tar + sha256, idempotent installer, documented uninstall, and upgrade manifests included.

carla: SOFT/DEFER: tenant-level canary wiring, extended metrics retention tweaks, and non-blocking telemetry optouts. these require mitigation plan and timeline.

elaine: owners: eng-runtime=jin, field-ops=ryan, product=elaine, security=omar. include owner & oncall in the one-pager.

ops-bot: :robot_face: Draft preflight page created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/PRIV-OnePager (review within 48h)

ryan: i'll add short troubleshooting snippets (tcpdump filters, kubectl logs, packet-capture commands) to the doc.

elaine: action items: jin -> add runtime rollback manifest + perf script (EOD), ryan -> peering lab checklist + pcap examples (tomorrow), omar -> KMS/audit snippet (EOD). i'll assemble and send to field on Friday.
